name: Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme
benefit: Free bicycles are provided to all girl students of 9th to 12th classes.
eligibility_rules: Girl students should be residents of Punjab state. Girl students should be studying in standards 9th,10th, 11th, and 12th in the government school. Girl students should belong to those below the poverty line (BPL).
documents_required: Identity card such as Aadhaar cardResident proofBPL cardCaste certificate if
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Applicants can also contact the principal of their concerned school regarding the Scheme. The application form will be provided by the concerned person. Fill up the application form and submit all the required Documents. Verification of the details of the applicant will be done by the concerned authority. After successful verification, the applicant can avail the benefit of the scheme.
